verdict.rationale: Docs show Asana has a developer platform (API, webhooks, rule actions, app components that plug into the Asana UI) enabling third-party integrations, which supports the general integrations story, but no evidence explicitly describes an 'app marketplace' or quantifies 'thousands' of available integrations. Missing for 10: explicit marketplace/app directory documentation, count or breadth of available third-party apps, and independent confirmation of marketplace scale.
